test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: The Causes and Effects of Plastic Bag Pollution
The Convenience of Plastic Bags: Ignoring the Negative Impact
The Consequences of a Damaged Ecosystem

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses both the causes and effects of plastic bag pollution in detail.
 
• It explains how plastic bags are widely used, their slow degradation, and the environmental damage they cause.
 
• The title "**The Causes and Effects of Plastic Bag Pollution**" accurately summarizes the key aspects of the passage.
 
• Other options, such as "The Convenience of Plastic Bags: Ignoring the Negative Impact," focus only on one aspect of the issue, making them less appropriate.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
